jei.asgardshield_core.giant_sword: A heavy sword that guards like a shield (hold right-click): it takes the hits instead of you and fills the Guard Gauge, but has no perks. Holding it without guarding lowers the damage you take.
jei.asgardshield_core.shield: Hold right-click to guard: the shield takes the hits instead of you and loses durability. Guarding fills the Guard Gauge above the food bar (gilded shields more slowly); when it is full the guard breaks until the gauge has emptied a good way. Holding the shield without guarding lowers the damage you take. With a shield in the hotbar the Vanguard Count above the hotbar fills up; when it is full, sneak while guarding to strike everything around you. Right-click with a sword switches to the shield of the hotbar, letting go switches back. Every shield has a special perk and a weakness. Dye shields like leather armour; six gold ingots around a shield gild it.
